notes: PHASE-000 foundation is complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 remains in progress and its acceptance criterion is not yet satisfied because approved desktop calling applications have not consumed processed/bypass audio through an OS-visible VSN virtual microphone. The verified Windows audio implementation includes Rust audio contracts and bounded queues, deterministic device selection/reselection, bounded stream recovery, IAudioClient3 shared-mode period planning, SharedCapturePlan cadence, event-driven WASAPI IAudioCaptureClient capture, native sample decoding, packet reframing and AudioFrame assembly, CaptureRuntime bounded reopen recovery, IMMNotificationClient delivery on a dedicated Windows MTA thread, owner-thread notification filtering/deduplication, fixed-format bounded VirtualMicStagingBuffer behavior, and VirtualMicOutputBridge processed/safe-bypass staging. The versioned Rust virtual-mic protocol and MSVC x64 C++ ABI mirror remain verified. Two additional native transport-boundary slices are now verified: vsn_virtual_mic_cursor_sync.h uses aligned Windows Interlocked 64-bit operations for bounded stable cursor snapshots, session-generation fencing, monotonic producer/consumer publication and atomic overrun/underrun counters; vsn_virtual_mic_region_layout.h defines a deterministic 64-byte-aligned header/cursor/PCM-ring geometry with overflow-safe mapping-size calculation. The cursor slice passed Ubuntu run 34530771449 and Windows run 34530771628 on head 29df8cf88878f14ec319e249562f3d25aa2efe30. The region-layout slice passed Ubuntu run 34531204947 and Windows run 34531204951 on head fafd5100d430d0880fe1dfe0671edf7537683fcf and was merged to main as 1e91b3ea285aa842956c72f35b6ed05da2ee06bd. These are user-mode synchronization/layout contracts only; they do not prove Windows section creation/mapping, a kernel-side synchronization counterpart, IOCTL/device-interface/ACL behavior, a WDK WaveRT endpoint, an OS-visible microphone, calling-application routing, physical hotplug/default-device recovery, hardware CPU/latency/jitter/deadline targets or driver signing/install/update/uninstall/rollback. README, execution-plan evidence and docs/architecture/WINDOWS-AUDIO-IMPLEMENTATION.md are reconciled to this boundary. The next valid WU-002 action is to implement the bounded Windows shared-section mapping/access-control transport boundary that consumes the verified region layout and cursor publication contract, without claiming WDK endpoint completion until actual driver build/test evidence exists. Paid provider usage, proprietary model training, production credentials/cloud spend and production deployment remain subject to applicable provider/data/compute/release gates.
